resources.string: Contacts access is needed to show labels
The label was not found. Create the shortcut again.

Add a home screen shortcut that opens contacts with a chosen label.
Tap the button below, or add a shortcut from the launcher: long-press the home screen → Widgets → Label Shortcut → Contact label.
Choose below where labels open: a contacts app or \"Label Shortcut list\". The list opens instantly and has buttons to call, send an SMS or open a chat in a messenger. Long-press the call or SMS button to choose a number.
